2. Chapter on Wheel Based on Purification of Words Pasodhanavāracakkavāra

Positive (Anuloma)

Faultless. Faultless dhamma? Yes. 19. Dhamma. Un-faultless dhamma? Un-faultless dhamma are both dhamma and un-faultless dhamma. The rests are dhamma, (but) not un-faultless dhamma. Faultless. Faultless dhamma? Yes. Dhamma. Indeterminate dhamma? Indeterminate dhamma are both dhamma and indeterminate dhamma. The rests are dhamma, (but) not indeterminate dhamma.

Un-faultless dhamma? Yes. Dhamma. Indeterminate dhamma? Indeterminate dhamma are both dhamma and indeterminate dhamma. The rests are dhamma, (but) not indeterminate dhamma.
